sections.heading: C2 — KG hints for Lane Use and Markings
sections.markdown:
## C2 — KG hints for Lane Use and Markings

FACT_ID: sec05-R01 | anchor: A01
White paint separates traffic flowing together, while yellow paint separates traffic flowing against each other [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint line-colors; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec05-F02.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec05-R02 | anchor: A01
Beside a solid yellow line you must hold your lane, while beside its dashed twin you may pass when safe [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint line-colors; prereq_hint sec05-F02; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec05-F03.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec05-R03 | anchor: A01
The stop line fixes where your vehicle must halt, while the crosswalk fixes where pedestrians cross and must be yielded to [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint stop-crosswalk; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec05-F05.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec05-R04 | anchor: A01
Painted crosswalks define the crossing zone, yet unpainted crossings carry the same pedestrian alert duty [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint stop-crosswalk; prereq_hint sec05-F05; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec05-F05 and sec05-F06.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec05-R05 | anchor: A01
Green opens the reversible lane and red closes it, while flashing yellow narrows it to turns and steady yellow evicts you [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint reversible-lanes; prereq_hint sec05-F08; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec05-F09.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec05-R06 | anchor: A02
The shared left-turn lane welcomes left turns from both directions with waiting allowed, while a reserved lane admits only its posted vehicle class [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint special-lanes; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec05-F10 and sec05-F11.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec05-R07 | anchor: A02
With at least two lanes moving the same way, the left lane is usually for passing. Driving on the shoulder is prohibited unless a traffic-control device or official instructs you to do it. Passing on any shoulder is prohibited, paved or unpaved. [A02]
Why it matters: group_hint lane-discipline; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec05-F12 and sec05-F13.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec05-R08 | anchor: A02
The left lane serves passing while the center lane serves heavy merging traffic, with cruising otherwise kept right or center [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint lane-discipline; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec05-F12.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec05-R09 | anchor: A03
Bike lanes grant cyclists exclusive marked space, while sharrows merely announce sharing with no exclusive zone [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint bike-markings; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec05-F15 and sec05-F18.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-R10 | anchor: A03
Green lane paint warns drivers crossing it, while the green bike box gives cyclists a full-width turning pocket at signals [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint bike-markings; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec05-F16 and sec05-F19.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-R11 | anchor: A03
Motorists may enter bike lanes only to turn with careful checks, while cyclists use detector marks to place themselves for a signal trigger [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint bike-markings; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec05-F17 and sec05-F20.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0017]
